title: Adult CPR
description: Respond to an adult who has collapsed and is not responding.

actions.label: Tap shoulders and shout to check response

steps.instruction: Make sure the area is safe for you and the casualty.
steps.hint: Look for traffic, fire, or electrical hazards.
Tap the shoulders firmly and speak loudly.

steps.instruction: Get emergency help on the way.
steps.hint: Send someone else if others are present.

steps.instruction: Check whether the person is breathing normally.
steps.hint: Look, listen, and feel for no more than ten seconds.
Centre of the chest, hard and fast.

steps.instruction: Give rescue breaths after the compressions.
steps.hint: Tilt the head back and lift the chin.

steps.instruction: Use the defibrillator as soon as it arrives.
